checks.name: ck_tenancies_end_reason
checks.expression: end_reason IS NULL OR end_reason IN ('TERM_ENDED','TENANT_INITIATED','OPERATOR_INITIATED','MUTUAL','OTHER')

checks.name: ck_tenancies_time_order
checks.expression: ended_at IS NULL OR started_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= started_at

checks.name: ck_tenancy_participants_time_order
checks.expression: left_at IS NULL OR left_at >= joined_at

checks.name: ck_charges_rent_no_utility
checks.expression: charge_type <> 'RENT' OR (utility_connection_id IS NULL AND start_meter_reading_id IS NULL AND end_meter_reading_id IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_charges_reading_requires_connection
checks.expression: utility_connection_id IS NOT NULL OR (start_meter_reading_id IS NULL AND end_meter_reading_id IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_payments_replacement_not_self
checks.expression: replacement_payment_id IS NULL OR replacement_payment_id <> payment_id

checks.name: ck_payments_replacement_requires_void
checks.expression: replacement_payment_id IS NULL OR voided_or_reversed_at IS NOT NULL

checks.name: ck_receipts_replacement_not_self
checks.expression: replacement_receipt_id IS NULL OR replacement_receipt_id <> receipt_id

checks.name: ck_receipts_status_voided_at
checks.expression: (status = 'ISSUED' AND voided_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'VOIDED' AND voided_at IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_deposit_events_provenance
checks.expression: (event_type = 'RECEIVED' AND payment_application_id IS NOT NULL AND settlement_id IS NULL) OR (event_type IN ('REFUNDED','RETAINED') AND settlement_id IS NOT NULL AND payment_application_id IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_incident_events_from_status
checks.expression: from_status IS NULL OR from_status IN ('REPORTED','ACKNOWLEDGED','IN_PROGRESS','RESOLVED','CLOSED','REJECTED')

checks.name: ck_incident_events_to_status
checks.expression: to_status IS NULL OR to_status IN ('REPORTED','ACKNOWLEDGED','IN_PROGRESS','RESOLVED','CLOSED','REJECTED')

checks.name: ck_reviews_response_coherence
checks.expression: (landlord_response IS NULL AND landlord_response_by_user_id IS NULL AND landlord_responded_at IS NULL) OR (landlord_response IS NOT NULL AND landlord_response_by_user_id IS NOT NULL AND landlord_responded_at IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_trust_reports_exactly_one_target
checks.expression: (listing_id IS NOT NULL) <> (review_id IS NOT NULL)

transactionGuards.description: Listing publish requires VACANT active Room under active Property.
Room leaving VACANT synchronously unpublishes current Listing.
Property archive rechecks child Room/Tenancy/Listing/Incident state.
Room archive requires INACTIVE, no nonterminal Tenancy, no open Incident.
Activate Tenancy only for eligible Room with exactly one active PRIMARY.
Ending/checkout FSM and Room state transition happen in one transaction.
Billing cycles for one Tenancy may not overlap.
Applied Terms belongs to same Tenancy and valid effective boundary.
Payment and allocated Charge must belong to same Tenancy.
Payment and Deposit application must belong to same Tenancy.
Allocation plus deposit application sum may not exceed Payment amount.
Replacement Payment must share Tenancy and predecessor must be voided/reversed.
Receipt may only be issued from eligible confirmed Payment.
Utility Connection belongs to Tenancy Room, type matches Charge, readings share Connection.
Deposit Event provenance type and amount must match Application/Settlement.
Cumulative Deposit Settlement refunded+retained amount may not exceed cumulative Deposit Payment Application amount for the same Deposit.
Archive transaction rechecks open Incident.
Review requires ENDED Tenancy and eligible linked Participant/User.
Review captures historical Property target and does not cascade on reassignment.
Payment Claim participant and resulting Payment must belong to same Tenancy.
Terms and Participant share Tenancy; action User matches linked Participant User.
Review author Participant belongs to Review Tenancy and links author User.
Replacement Receipt belongs to same Payment and predecessor is VOIDED.

openPolicies: Deposit requirement change after partially held
Charge over-allocation across multiple Payments targeting one Charge
